summary: Both backend and frontend tested for WhatsApp-clone. 15/15 pytest cases pass covering auth (register/login/me/patch), users, chats (direct idempotent + group + list), messages (send/list/mark-read/empty-rejected), websocket (invalid token rejected + valid connect + broadcast on new message), and file upload/download. Frontend Playwright E2E: login (alice@test.com), register with random email + auto-login, chats tab visible, new-chat contacts list, tap user-row starts direct chat, send text via message-input + send-message-button appears in list, back reflects last_message on chats tab, Setelan tab shows settings-screen with edit-about + save-about + logout-button, logout returns to /(auth)/login. Note: 'edit-about' is a Pressable row that opens an inline TextInput; save-about button works. Broadcast dedupe by message id on client verified — no duplicate render observed.

issues: React Native web deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated, use 'boxShadow' (non-blocking, cosmetic)

action_items: (Optional) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence RN-Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py excludes MongoDB _id in all read projections — good.
broadcast_chat also sends to sender; client dedupes by message id — E1 confirmed and observed OK.
download endpoint accepts token via query string OR Authorization header — supports web .
Passwords hashed with bcrypt; JWT_SECRET from env; email lowercased on register/login — good.
server.py is 631 lines — approaching split threshold (700). Consider modularizing (auth, chats, ws) in future.
seed_data_creation: Registered ephemeral pw_*@t.com users via /auth/register during tests; created TEST_grp group chats and direct chats between alice+bob. No cleanup performed (dev DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All /api routes verified. WS URL = wss://<host>/api/ws?token=JWT. Alice/Bob seeded. Run: `set -a && source /app/frontend/.env && set +a && pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. For frontend, use testIDs: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, go-to-register, register-{name,email,password}-input, register-submit-button, chats-screen, new-chat-button, empty-new-chat, new-chat-screen, user-row-{id}, message-input, send-message-button, settings-screen, edit-about (Pressable row — tap to open inline TextInput), save-about, logout-button.
